evidence.summary: AC-17 requires visual effects to be rendered when the game runs in the browser. The VFX implementation code is complete in renderer.js and wired in ui.js, but index.html at the frozen candidate (f7bb745) only loads galaxy.js, game-state.js, and main.js. The Renderer module is never loaded, so no visual effects (parallax starfield, hyperspace, docking screen, HUD, combat VFX) are rendered at runtime.
